publicEvidenceLevels.meaning: Official/documented claims checked against cited documentation.
Offline syntax/simulation evidence only; never implies Screeps runtime verification.
Single-runtime observation tied to Game.time and controlled capture provenance.
Multi-tick runtime observation with an explicit tick window.

invariants: contentId is the durable evidence owner; articleSlug is only the current locator.
Evidence keys created by identity version 2 do not depend on articleSlug.
Database acceptance alone is not public truth; the matching Markdown verification flag must also be accepted.
Rejected and revoked evidence remain internal audit history and are never public.
Console and live claims require structured accepted runtime evidence; docs/offline claims do not enter verification_evidence.
A slug rename must preserve contentId/contentGroupId and update only the locator stored with evidence.
